warning: Signals are evidence summaries, not safety or ragging scores. Anonymous posts establish that a claim was publicly reported, not that it is universally true. National Anti-Ragging complaint rows establish recorded complaints/classifications, not adjudicated truth or causation.
method: Separate current lived reports, public artifacts, formal complaint history, established disciplinary reporting and official prevention material.
Do not identify an unnamed college from commenter speculation.
Do not convert older footage into evidence about the 2026 batch without date support.
Do not infer absence of ragging from absence of indexed reports.
Preserve contradictory accounts and grade current confidence separately from historical/formal confidence.
